content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?P e a c e f u l's PostP e a c e f u lApril 1 at 4:38 PM · Shared with Public BREAKING: Blood Moon Tonight! Skywatchers, get ready! A stunning Lunar Eclipse is expected tonight, turning the Moon into a deep blood red for nearly an hour This rare celestial moment happens when Earth’s shadow fully covers the Moon, filtering sunlight and casting that eerie red glow across its surface. At peak, the color could appear darker and more intense than usual—making it a breathtaking sight even from city areas. Best viewed after sunset No telescope needed Perfect chance for night sky photographyTag your friends and don’t miss this incredible event—step outside and witness the sky transform!APRIL FOOL DAY!
